name: Farmer Saldean
summary: At Saldean's Farm in central Westfall, Farmer Saldean and his wife, Salma, keep working troubled fields. Other farmers flee or give up, but he faces rogue harvest golems and growing banditry.

sections.title: Holding the Plow
sections.body:
Farmer Saldean remembers Westfall before its prosperity crumbled. Overgrown fields, rampaging mechanical harvest watchers, and predatory bandits now surround his farm. Yet he refuses to yield his land.

Other homesteaders have abandoned their acres or turned to thievery. Saldean and his wife, Salma, stay to harvest what little grain they can. He asks wandering adventurers to destroy the rogue Harvest Watchers in his fields and his neighbors' fields, so he can clear the soil for planting.

sections.title: The Scythe of Westfall
sections.body:
Between Sentinel Hill and the northern bridge, Saldean's defense of his homestead helps keep civilian life going. He remains tied to the People's Militia despite the hard times. Once his immediate troubles are settled, he sends able-bodied travelers to Gryan Stoutmantle.

Clearing the wild harvest reapers can give his farm only a temporary reprieve. The lawlessness strangling the countryside still has to be dealt with.

faq.answer: Farmer Saldean is a veteran human farmer at Saldean's Farm in Westfall, where he lives with his wife, Salma. Though famine, rogue harvest golems, and growing banditry threaten his land, he refuses to abandon it.

faq.q: Why is Farmer Saldean's farm in trouble?
faq.answer: Westfall's automated harvest golems have malfunctioned and gone wild. They prowl cropland and attack anyone in sight, so Saldean needs adventurers to destroy the mechanical watchers in his fields and neighboring fields and reclaim his land.

faq.q: Where can Farmer Saldean be found?
faq.answer: Farmer Saldean can be found outside his farmhouse at Saldean's Farm, just off the main road in central Westfall and north of Sentinel Hill.

faq.q: Does Saldean support the People's Militia?
faq.answer: Yes. Saldean is busy defending his crops and home, but he directs capable adventurers down the road to Gryan Stoutmantle at Sentinel Hill to help the People's Militia defend the region.

faq.q: What unique items does Saldean sell?
faq.answer: Saldean sells staple bread and Special Chicken Feed, a curious grain sought by travelers hoping to befriend the local fowl wandering Westfall.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you see Saldean's stubborn resolve among Westfall's remaining loyalists. They cling to Kingdom soil even when the crown's soldiers are nowhere to be seen.
Farmers like Saldean are the crumbling backbone of Stormwind's food supply. Securing his crop keeps basic bread on tables across the kingdom.
